title: Ada and the Cipher
author: O. M. Almeida
blurb: Coral Quintana, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
